description: A durable, queryable store for the estate's domain records. What it is NOT: an event bus (that is ABB.05), a blob store (ABB.06), or an in-process cache (not an ABB at all — implementations may hold one internally). The role names a function; PostgreSQL, ADLS, BLOB, XYZ or CaaS may all fill the slot as long as they satisfy `requiredCapabilities` and answer the `protocol` verbs.
